thread:
toni: Heads-up: employee E-204 reported they hit the 401(k) deferral limit after a retro bonus was applied. Need to run an excess deferral distribution. Anyone handled this recently?

rahul-bene: Yep, we do this when year-to-date elective deferrals > IRS limit. Which plan year and total dollar over?

toni: Plan year 2025. Looks like $2,100 over the $23k limit (employee is under 50, no catch-up). Bonus processed as retro pay on 12/29 and deferrals applied across payrolls.

finance-sarah: Okay. Two things: 1) we must request an excess deferral distribution from recordkeeper and issue a corrective payment to the employee (grossed up or not?) 2) taxes: the distributed excess is taxable in the year contributed, and earnings on the excess are taxable in the year distributed. We'll need payroll to produce a W-2 adjustment or issue Form 1099-R for earnings depending on timing.

payroll-joe: For payroll side we can generate a corrective off-cycle payment code. What file layout does BrightPlan need for an EXCESS distribution? @ben-plan

ben-plan: BrightPlan here. Use file type "EXDIST" with fields: SSN, amount_excess, original_contrib_dates, earnings_amount, reason_code=EX_OVER. Mark distribution_date and employee election if they want direct distribution vs rollover. If distributed by Jan 31 we treat as timely per plan docs.

toni: Employee prefers to receive the excess back to their bank, not roll over. Is there an after-tax withholding on the excess?

finance-sarah: The excess elective amount was already included in taxable wages when withheld, so the distributed principal is not double-taxed — but earnings on the excess are taxable when distributed and subject to withholding. For payroll we should withhold federal income tax on earnings per employee election or default supplemental rate. We'll coordinate with payroll.

rahul-bene: Confirming plan allows corrective distribution to employee. Also need employee signed election form for distribution method; I'll DM Toni a PDF.

payroll-joe: Noted. Payroll will run off-cycle EX_DIST on 2026-01-12 if we have the EXDIST file by EOD 01/10. We'll use deduction code: ```CSV
code,description
EX_DIST,excess 401k distribution (non-rollover)
EARN_EX,earnings on excess (taxable)
```

ben-plan: Also include field "ELECTION" values: "CASH" or "ROLLOVER". If CASH, we'll mail a confirmation and send the 1099-R for earnings. If ROLLOVER, we'll accept a trustee-to-trustee rollover file.

toni: Sounds good. Action list: 1) Rahul to send signed employee election by EOD 01/08 2) Payroll to prepare EXDIST file and off-cycle run 3) Finance to prepare tax withholding guidance and W-2/1099-R handling 4) Benefits to record plan-level memo. Anyone object?

finance-sarah: No objections. Small note: since the excess stems from retro bonus, please document whether employer match associated with retro pay incorrectly matched on the excess; we may need to correct employer match contributions separately.

rahul-bene: Got it. I'll check match and upload signed election to ticket INC-8052.

benefits-bot: Reminder: attach supporting docs to the benefits ticket within 7 days to meet audit requirements.

toni: Thanks all. I'll close when EXDIST processed and 1099-R/adjusted W-2s guidance finalized.
